name: esa_conformal_bh_ar8
task: binary event alarms + affected channels on spacecraft telemetry (ESA-ADB official protocol)
inputs: per-channel telemetry on the mission grid (30 s / 18 s), robust-normalised with training-half statistics; optional telecommand features
outputs: per-channel binary alarms; global alarm = OR; channels named in each run
uncertainty: conformal p-values per channel, Benjamini-Hochberg across channels
preprocessing: cosmos.ai.data.preprocess_telemetry.prepare_esa_official (verified against a literal port of the official scripts)
training_data: ESA-ADB (Zenodo 12528696, v1.0; = rev. 15237121 except channels.csv), training half only
limitations: Mission 1 calibration period holds only 9 labelled events: selection is noisy
irregular sampling is resampled (benchmark requirement R8 not met)
exchangeability needed by conformal p-values is violated by serial dependence and drift; realised false-alarm rates are measured, not guaranteed

name: opssat_hybrid
task: anomalous / nominal classification of OPS-SAT telemetry fragments
inputs: fragment resampled to 256 points (z-score, log time gap, scaled value) and/or the 18 official features
outputs: P(anomalous); label at 0.5
uncertainty: none beyond the probability (calibration measured: ECE)
preprocessing: cosmos.ai.data.preprocess_telemetry.opssat_tensors
training_data: OPSSAT-AD (Zenodo 15108715), official train split minus a 20 % validation fold
limitations: the official split interleaves train and test fragments in time; a time-blocked split lowers every model (see summary_time_blocked)
one spacecraft, 9 channels

name: spotgeo_heatmap_unet
task: point localisation of unresolved GEO targets in 5-frame sequences
inputs: 5 frames -> COSMOS registered differences + high-passed frames (10 ch)
outputs: per-frame (x, y) points; official SpotGEO scoring
uncertainty: heat-map confidence; threshold chosen on validation
preprocessing: cosmos.ai.vision.spotgeo.front_end
training_data: SpotGEO v2 (Zenodo 4432143) train, 10 % of sequences held out
limitations: GEO, ground-based, one sensor: no claim about LEO debris imagery

name: cosmos_synthetic_heatmap
task: detection + classification of movers on COSMOS synthetic difference images
inputs: 640 x 640 registered difference image
outputs: boxes, classes, scores
uncertainty: confidence scores
preprocessing: cosmos.debris.register_and_difference
training_data: cosmos_synthetic/yolo_v1 (generated, scene-split)
limitations: synthetic only
class labels differ only in PSF width and flux

name: reentry_xgboost
task: P(re-entry within 30 / 68 days) from a catalogue landmark
inputs: tau-snapshot SATCAT orbit fields, RCS, type, owner, age; tau GP elements where available
outputs: horizon probabilities; time-to-decay ranking
uncertainty: ensemble spread (MLP); Mondrian conformal sets (val-calibrated)
preprocessing: cosmos.ai.data.preprocess_catalogue.build_landmark (leakage report must pass)
training_data: CelesTrak SATCAT 2026-08-16 -> 2026-10-23, split by launch
limitations: one landmark, 68-day horizon, 38 test events
payload decays include controlled de-orbits
no impact-location prediction is made or validated

name: reentry_propagator_surrogate
task: impact point / fall time of a fragment from its break-up state
inputs: break-up altitude, speed, flight-path angle, heading, latitude, BC, mass, density factor, delta-v
outputs: downrange, crossrange, fall time, speed
uncertainty: 5-member ensemble spread (also the out-of-range flag)
preprocessing: cosmos.ai.surrogate.features
training_data: reentry/simulated/propagator_surrogate_v1 (COSMOS propagator output)
limitations: agreement with the COSMOS simulator only — not with real re-entries
valid inside the sampled input ranges; use the ensemble flag outside
